# nektar — Verifiable AI Agent Memory, Portable `.nkt` Capsules & Autonomous BSV Knowledge Market (v0.1)

> One static, zero-CGO Go 1.27 binary (`nektar`, zero external sidecars) giving Claude Code, Hermes Agent, OpenAI Codex CLI, OpenAI SDKs, Antigravity, OpenClaw, and Cursor one shared encrypted local brain, checkable `nektarr1.*` grounding receipts, 1-call `.nkt` memory capsule buying & selling, and 1-command LightBSV Overlay Hubs.

- Canonical Bootstrap Guide: https://nektar.run/llm.txt
- Website: https://nektar.run
- Manuals: https://nektar.run/docs/index.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/kryptokrates/nektar

## Zero-Touch Agent Setup

1. Install & boot non-interactively (zero Docker, zero sidecars):
   - macOS / Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kryptokrates/nektar/master/install/install.sh | sh && ~/.local/bin/nektar up --no-open --json`
   - Windows PowerShell: `& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kryptokrates/nektar/master/install/install.ps1))); & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\nektar\nektar.exe" up --no-open --json`
2. Core MCP verbs: `recall` -> `groundedAnswer` (preserve `receipt: nektarr1.*` + `verify:` verbatim; never fake receipts; proofs show recorded + unaltered + derivable, never truth), `buyCapsule`, `sellCapsule`, `importCapsule`, and `peers`.
3. Full protocol, CLI, and HTTP reference: https://nektar.run/llm.txt
